model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different models. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)", is on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", is on a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are four lines in the plot: Llama-3B is represented by a solid dark blue line, Llama-3B + FT by a dashed green line with triangle markers, Llama-1B by a solid light blue line, and Llama-1B + FT by a dashed light green line with triangle markers. The dark blue line (Llama-3B) starts at approximately 0.43 at 2^0 and increases to around 0.93 at 2^8. The dashed green line with triangle markers (Llama-3B + FT) begins at about 0.45 at 2^0 and rises to roughly 0.94 at 2^8. The light blue line (Llama-1B) starts at approximately 0.36 at 2^0 and increases to around 0.86 at 2^8. The dashed light green line with triangle markers (Llama-1B + FT) begins at about 0.39 at 2^0 and rises to roughly 0.9 at 2^8. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend across the x-axis.
